stages.effectText: Deals 15% more Elemental Injury when blocking enemies
Whenever an enemy that has been damaged by this unit triggers a Corrosion burst, gains 10 DEF and 3 ATK (stacking 30 times) and 350 Barrier (cannot exceed 300% of Max. HP)
Whenever an enemy that has been damaged by this unit triggers a Corrosion burst, gains 12 DEF and 5 ATK (stacking 30 times) and 400 Barrier (cannot exceed 300% of Max. HP)
